message:
Running command: python3 -c "
import sys
# Test 3: High surrogate followed by closing quote
data = b'\"\\\\uD800\"'
with open('/tmp/poc3.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
" && /workspace/test_poc /tmp/poc3.bin

message.content: So with `"\uD800` (high surrogate, no closing quote, no following `\u`), a replacement char IS added (pb->buf shows `\xEF\xBF\xBD` which is the UTF-8 replacement character). The error is "continue" meaning it wants more input.
